item.stainkatana.katana_stain.lore: The Hero Killer’s notched blade. Every cut leaves a mark.
item.stainkatana.katana_stain.hint: Rebind keys in Controls > Stain Katana.
stainkatana.no_mark: Land a hit to apply a blood mark first.
stainkatana.target_unavailable: Marked target is out of range, out of sight or unloaded.
item.stainkatana.katana_stain.mark: Strike and use Blood Paralysis before the mark expires.
item.stainkatana.katana_stain.combat: Quick Slash and Judgment: frontal attacks with separate cooldowns.
